AC3 evidence [non-codebase]. The 14 follow-up tickets exist and each carries an OUTBOUND discovered_from edge to this task. Verified child-side, because rebar deps on THIS task shows only its own outbound edges and cannot surface inbound ones — which is why AC3 is tagged [non-codebase] and why its original verification command was wrong.

Command, run against every child:
  for t in <the 14 ids>; do rebar deps $t | grep discovered_from; done
Result: 14 / 14 children carry the edge.

The 14, each proposing generate-or-gate for one genuine mirror from reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md:
  545a-4db5-3a64-42d9  F1  reducer event-type dispatch (HIGH, silent data loss)
  fd6b-09c5-8f76-45ad  F12 docs/exit-codes.md drifted + false gate claim (HIGH)
  0d3c-ff25-5317-4d73  F13 code-review gate step ids unvalidated (HIGH)
  62eb-5e6f-512a-420d  F5  MCP output models re-type canonical enums (HIGH)
  e755-9371-7951-454a  F3  plan-review ticket-type exemption, six sites (HIGH)
  cacb-8d57-efff-4ab1  F4  blocking/non-blocking relation partition (MEDIUM)
  a691-f454-92c5-49bd  F10 three doc enumerations drifted (MEDIUM)
  6850-af5c-a4a1-4c5d  F2  op-cert kinds, three masters (MEDIUM)
  a516-e61b-ede9-465c  F6  TicketStatus re-declared in the reducer (MEDIUM)
  ce8f-4da9-2836-4115  F7  TicketType re-declared on the create path (MEDIUM)
  91b0-6185-b53c-4271  F8  CANONICAL_RELATIONS not pinned to the schema (LOW)
  70f5-2253-1671-474d  F9  config precedence layers, two masters (LOW)
  1daf-a435-2387-412c  F11 cross-session warn verb spellings (LOW)
  0af1-44ec-0b47-4611  F14 the 17 mutating verbs, three masters (LOW)
All 14 are parented under epic undamaged-murderous-horse (f79d-0d71-0fd7-439f), which is linked
relates_to this epic's parent 87cb-7121-a3b6-4606.
